mapper.select: SELECT status FROM practice_sessions WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND record_deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT ps.id AS session_id, ps.song_id, s.title AS song_title, s.note_count, ps.score_version, ps.start_note_idx, ps.end_note_idx, ps.bpm, ps.bpm_unit, ps.status, ps.started_at, ps.recording_duration_ms, e.total_score, ps.saved_at, ps.memo FROM practice_sessions ps JOIN songs s ON s.id = ps.song_id LEFT JOIN evaluations e ON e.session_id = ps.id WHERE ps.id = #{sessionId} AND ps.user_id = #{userId} AND ps.record_deleted_at IS NULL
